anya_data: Heads-up: AltChip lab is ready for the joint benchmark handoff tomorrow AM. Need to confirm final workload matrix, telemetry endpoints, artifact signing, and the marketplace assets. Anyone object to a short dry-run at 10am PT?

lee_altchip: 10am PT works. We'll bring the kernel patch bundle (altchip_patch_2026.tar.gz) and a small helper that toggles power c-states. We need the canonical workload JSON and the tag schema so our CSV lines map to your dashboards.

sam_eng: Workload matrix (final):
- gen_long: model=redwood/llama-70b, seq=2048, batch=1, prompt=1ktok, duration=10m
- chat_burst: model=redwood/llama-70b, seq=512, batch=8, openai_chat_style, sustained 10m
- embed_bulk: model=redwood/opt-13b-embed, seq=128, batch=64, throughput window 5m
Notes: collect histograms for tokens/sec (1s bins), p50/p95/p99 latencies, and per-GPU power (watts) at 1s resolution.

bench-bot: reproducible command (use benchctl v2.1):
```
benchctl run --partner=altchip --workload=gen_long --model=redwood/llama-70b \
  --seq=2048 --batch=1 --duration=600 --sensors=ipmi,pmbus,gpu_temp \
  --tags=run_id,model,kernel_tag,fw_rev,rack
```
Export CSV and the raw prometheus snapshot (prom-snapshot.tar.gz). Attach kernel_tag as git sha.

ryan_sre: Telemetry/infra checklist:
- Open port only from altchip-tx host IPs (we will provide list) to telemetry endpoint (pull mode preferred).
- Prometheus pushgateway allowed for bench runs.
- Audit event when we ship metrics externally (who, what, dataset id).
- KMS signing: marketplace artifacts must be signed by Redwood key and partner key; coordinate with security before publishing.

lee_altchip: kernel knobs we plan to enable: ALTC_PWERMODE=turbo, ALTC_KTUNE=4, sparse-attn-v2, memory_allocator=jemalloc. We'll document the exact patchset and provide a small script toggle_knobs.sh. Also sending altchip_therm_v4.json for thermal expectations.

olivia_pm: Marketplace checklist for marketing:
- Validated perf PDF (60p)
- One-liner partner blurb (two options)
- Logos: svg and png (white & color)
- Marketplace AMI/container with tags and signed manifest
- Embargo window: propose 12 business days after internal sign-off
We need internal sign-off by next Tue to hit product marketing timelines.

maria: Owners: Sam = harness + metrics format; Lee = kernel bundle + thermals; Ryan = telemetry policy + signing; Olivia = marketplace assets + embargo coordination; Anya = partner logistics + lab schedule. If dry-run shows thermal throttling, capture frequency scaling trace and mark run "throttle=true".

sam_eng: I'll push the workload JSON to the shared S3: s3://redwood-bench/altchip/2026-03/matrix.json and add a README with expected output fields. Will also include a small parser script parse_altchip_csv.py.

lee_altchip: We'll attempt a warmup-only run tonight to validate sensors. Expect CSV back by 1pm PT tomorrow if all green.

ryan_sre: Also: remember to run with system telemetry offload disabled for these runs so sensor polling is consistent. Tag any run with nonstandard PDU limits.

anya_data: Great. If no blockers I'll send calendar invite for 10am PT and attach the S3 link. Thanks all. :pray:
